human_summary: List owner questions that must be answered or explicitly deferred before governed implementation planning.

questions.question: What should the first useful version of this product do for the owner?
questions.why_it_matters: The first workflow determines the initial capability and acceptance criteria.

options.label: Narrow first version
options.description: Deliver one complete owner-approved workflow first.

options.label: Owner-defined scope
options.description: Owner lists exactly what is in and out.
options.tradeoff: Best fit, requires more owner input.

questions.default_recommendation: Use the workflow with the clearest acceptance criteria.

options.label: Narrow MVP
options.description: Deliver the smallest coherent workflow first.

options.label: Broader MVP
options.description: Include more workflow coverage in the initial plan.

owner_decision_cards.recommendation: Prefer the narrow MVP unless the owner confirms broader scope.
owner_decision_cards.impact: This decision controls which capabilities can move into specification and future planning.
owner_decision_cards.risk: Unclear scope can produce invalid downstream task packets.
owner_decision_cards.required_owner_action: Select one option or provide revised scope.
